verdict.rationale: Postman docs reference Variables and Environments (postman-docs-47, postman-docs-52) as core building blocks that let users switch request configurations, which is Postman's standard mechanism for dev/staging/prod switching, but the evidence pack lacks dedicated first-party documentation explicitly walking through creating multiple named environments and switching between them via the environment selector, nor any hands-on community confirmation of this specific workflow. missing for 10: dedicated docs/walkthrough on creating and switching between multiple environments (dev/staging/prod), independent/community corroboration of this specific workflow, and detail on environment-scoped variable inheritance/overrides.
